# TASK: Create a video for Lumen

You are going to create a video for the company Lumen, which makes a desk lamp that follows the sun.

## 1. The script
The video script is in the file ad-script.txt. Make sure you read it properly and extract its complete content.

## 2. Quality bar
The video must be impressive and of very high quality: AAA production level, with a cinematic style.

## 3. Tools and credentials
The choice of tools is up to you. Go all out. You can use motion graphics, AI video generation, 3D graphics, or whatever else you need to make the video look very high quality.

### OpenAI (image generation, or anything else you need)
The API key is in OPENAI_API_KEY.

Suggestion: create a character sheet image with an OpenAI image generation model, so characters stay consistent when you generate videos with Seedance or another strong model.

### ElevenLabs (sound and narration)
The API key is in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

Voice: find a good commercial voice, or use "Studio", my cloned voice.

### Higgsfield (video generation)
The API key is in HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY.

- Use high-quality models such as Seedance 2.5.
- Budget: $20 maximum on Higgsfield. Spend it wisely.
